claims: Artemis 2 reentry and splashdown is on April 10, 2026.
Coverage of Artemis 2 reentry and splashdown begins around 6:30 p.m. EDT (2230 GMT) on NASA's YouTube channel, NASA+, and the NASA app.
Orion capsule will splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
Orion capsule will splash down around 8:07 p.m. EDT (5 p.m. PDT/0007 GMT April 11).
Orion capsule will hit the atmosphere at ~24,000 mph.
Orion capsule reentry generates a fireball that is crucial to test the heat shield.
According to officials, Southern Californians will likely not be able to see the re-entry or splashdown in person.
Artemis 2 mission returns Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis 2 mission astronauts complete a 10-day trip around the Moon.
